network_isolation.details: 100% offline operation. Zero external API calls, tracking beacons, or telemetry.

filesystem_scoping.details: Read/write operations are strictly restricted to .remembrall.md and local project configuration files.

prompt_injection_defense.details: Feature entries are strictly parsed with fixed regex patterns and table column limits, preventing prompt injection payloads.

subagent_isolation.details: All state transitions use physical disk files, preventing cross-agent context leakage.

code_safety.details: Pure Python standard library implementation with zero unverified third-party PyPI dependencies.
